question: Who benefits from accessible food?
expectedObservationsText: Twenty Creambuds and twenty Brothmakers scattered on a protein patch. Neither can eat protein; Brothmakers release protein enzyme that turns it into broth, which both of them drink. Diverse Founders: a few founders may start with an extra ability, present at creation.
